architecture.memory: Intrinsic epistemic Memory Graph v8 with Main-authored consolidation and associative recall cues
architecture.runtime: Mechanical truth, safety, persistence, Evidence/Material, Coverage/Frontier, budgets, transactions
architecture.adapter: Transport-only local boundary on port 8080 for remote OpenAI-compatible APIs

contracts.wire: Main emits tolerant simple wire; Eyle canonicalizes and semantically validates strict ECC locally.
contracts.memory: Retention is lifecycle, not truth. Epistemic/temporal metadata and relations are Main-authored and historically revisable.
contracts.recall: FTS5/SQL candidate discovery is literal/mechanical; exact match sets are DB-cursor paged and Main judges relevance.
contracts.frontier: Frontier is exact continuation after the current materialized page, never a semantic reading limit.
contracts.adapter: Adapter remains semantically blind and negotiates transport mechanics through the formal handshake.
contracts.execution: Confirmation/resume preserves logical identity, absolute deadline, generated-token fuse, and provider usage.
contracts.source: workspace and eyle are physical source identities, never inferred semantically.
